WVC_XenotypesAndGenes.XaG_MutantDef.label: skeletal-duplicate
WVC_XenotypesAndGenes.XaG_MutantDef.description: A person who was created as a mindless duplicate.\n\nAbout skeletons: A rough skeletal duplicate created and animated by archites. They are the "hands" of their originals, and their skills are copied from the originals. Their only purpose is work; these empty shells are good for nothing else.
WVC_XenotypesAndGenes.XaG_MutantDef.deathLetter: One of your skeletons has died.
WVC_XenotypesAndGenes.XaG_MutantDef.deathLetterExtra: Unlike regular colonists, skeletons do not need to be buried and their death will not upset others. You may choose to bury them should you wish.

HediffDef.label: skeleton
HediffDef.description: This persona was created as a mindless duplicate. They lack their own consciousness and are psychically linked to their originals. They are tools capable only of performing tasks.
